visualCharacteristics.purpose: News listing with the first article featured large and the rest in a row of smaller cards
notes: Cream background; uppercase h2 "Latest News" with sub-line, outline pill "Explore more" button right; first article featured large (image left, big uppercase title, excerpt, date), remaining 3 in a row of smaller cards (image, ARTICLE label, title, date).

slider option (Related Articles on newsroom articles, white section): all cards equal width, image + label + title + date, in a horizontal scroll-snap track with round prev/next arrow buttons; no featured card.

contentPattern.structure: one row per article: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = type label paragraph (e.g. Article) + title heading with link + optional excerpt + date paragraph
patterns: first card featured large (image left, excerpt)
remaining cards in a row: image, type label, title, date
slider option: no featured card; equal-width cards in a horizontal scroll-snap track with prev/next buttons
blockContent: 4 news article cards linking to newsroom detail pages: image, type label "Article", title, optional excerpt, date; first one featured

usage.description: Latest news teasers on landing pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for article teasers where the first is featured. Use the slider option for a row of related articles that scrolls horizontally. Use cards for equal-weight cards.
